title: Muscle Mass Can Shrink 35%
hook: Muscle loss starts quietly, then accelerates later in life.
closing: Strength training matters because muscle loss compounds long before it feels urgent.
question: How often do you strength-train?

segments.say: Muscle mass can fall 35% by later life, quietly reducing strength and resilience.
Muscle loss reaches 18% per decade later in life, making delay increasingly costly.
After 12 weeks of lifting, clinical muscle loss fell to none in one study.
